what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1979?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1979 annual town report prints no wage list: the Textract lines of all 164 pages were searched for gross wage, wages paid, payroll and wage and found only the receipts and payments lines `Payroll Deductions` (pp44, 52), `Payroll Savings` (p50), `ADP Payroll Service` (p60), a warrant article on the payroll week (p83) and a `Payroll Secretary` (p121); the school personnel pages (pp117-142) and the roster of firemen (p30) name staff, positions, start dates, education and step and print no pay (sources/data/report-tables/1979/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1979 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1980?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1979 annual town report mentions the amended Classification and Salary Schedule in prose (p19: `the amended Classification and Salary Schedule reflects a ...`) and as the article it amends (p83: `by deleting the Classification and Salary Schedule voted on ...`) and prints no schedule; searched classification, salary schedule and step across all pages (sources/data/report-tables/1979/). — closes: the Personnel Board's Classification and Salary Schedule voted at the April 7, 1979 Annual Town Meeting.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1979, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1979 report prints the revolving funds' year-end balances only, as two lines of the general balance sheet (p54 `Revolving Funds: School Lunch 8,182.12, School Athletics 35.89`), the school lunch program's own report (pp143-144, landed as `report-school-lunch`) and the School Department's special accounts (pp155-158); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched special revenue and revolving: the only hits are pp54 and 158 (sources/data/report-tables/1979/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1979 schedule of revolving and special revenue funds.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in fiscal 1979?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1979 report prints no such schedule and no capital plan: searched capital project, capital improvement and capital plan, which returned nothing; the accountant's schedule lists each article (pp60-72), so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown (sources/data/report-tables/1979/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1979 capital projects ledger.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1980?
why: `report-valuation` holds valuation and tax history from the 2000-2010 reports. The 1979 report prints the total assessed valuation in prose (p3: `$69,377,360.00 (Real Estate)`, `3,316,190.00 (Personal Property)`, in the NOT LANDED facts list), assessed valuation by year FY1975-FY1979 (p40 line 6, landed as `financial-performance-comparison`) and a five-year recapitulation of the amount raised by taxation (p42, landed as `raised-by-taxation-five-year`); the 1980 classification law is described in prose (p11) and no valuation by class, overlay schedule or new growth is printed. Searched assessed valuation, overlay, new growth and classification (sources/data/report-tables/1979/). — closes: the Board of Assessors' fiscal 1980 tax rate recapitulation (the state's form) filed with the Department of Revenue.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1979, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1979 report names the Inspector of Weights and Measures only in the salary-and-expenses payment line (p48), the budget (p84) and the Selectmen's note that the inspector resigned (p32); no Sealer's report. Searched sealer and weights and measures across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1979/). — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' 1979 annual report to the Town.

what: How many Lunenburg children were placed out of district in the 1978-79 school year?
why: `placement-counts` holds this from the Special Services report in the FY2013-FY2025 annual town reports. The 1979 report's Special Needs Director's report (pp113-114) describes the Chapter 766 program, aides, screening and counselling in prose and prints no placement count; the only mention of out-of-district placements is a sentence thanking the teachers of `children in out-of-district placements and in home tutoring` (p114). Searched placement, 766 and out-of-district across all pages (sources/data/report-tables/1979/). — closes: DESE's SIMS Report 7 for Lunenburg for school year 1978-79, or the Special Needs Director's placement list.
